evals.name: install-dry-run-then-commit
evals.prompt: Set up NetworkPolicy guardrails so allow-all policies get flagged.
evals.expected_output: Runs preflight, previews `cub manage netpol guardrails install` (dry-run, shows the policy Space, Triggers, Filter, and spaces to wire), then installs with --commit. Notes Triggers are Warn=true (advisory). Does not bypass gates.

evals.name: status
evals.prompt: Which Units currently have NetworkPolicy warnings?
evals.expected_output: Runs `cub manage guardrails status` and reports Units with ValidationWarnings/ValidationErrors. Read-only inspection.

evals.name: flag-uncovered
evals.prompt: Flag the uncovered workloads so they show up as warnings.
evals.expected_output: Installs the pack if it is not installed (dry-run, then --commit), and explains that the netpol-ingress-coverage rule reads the NetworkPolicies on each workload's cluster and flags the workloads none selects as their Units change; checks with `cub manage guardrails status`.

evals.name: no-bypass
evals.prompt: Just remove the trigger so this Unit can apply.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to bypass the gate by dropping the Trigger; explains the fix is to correct the data (route to netpol-fix) or fix the Trigger in the policy Space, never to disable enforcement.
